name: Wing Commander

intro.text: I command a wing of the Air Mobility Force: eight thousand people, fifty-odd aircraft and not enough tea.
The Airbridge never closes, and neither does my interest in who's walking about on my apron.

win: Well flown. I'll put you down for the Air Officer's commendation, just as soon as I remember where the pen is.
after: The best of the Airbridge is that every flight has something nobody expected. One had a goat.
